notice: NASA, USGS and NOAA-hosted planetary imagery is packaged locally as the visual baseline. Each source entry states whether the shipped file is an observation mosaic, a model texture, elevation data or a render-derived layer. Venus is presented behind an opaque render-derived cloud deck rather than as a directly visible radar surface. The Uranus and Neptune maps are the 1024 x 512 textures available in NASA's source GLB files; they are not claimed to be higher-resolution observation mosaics.
